observations.efficient_candidate: obs/chirps-v3-daily-rhiza via public GCS Zarr; local pinned catalogue/integration test describes0.25-degree daily data2000 to approximatelymid2024, cropped before compute. Appropriate for retrospective2016, not current2026 verification.
observations.scientific_limit: CHIRPS3daily is temporal disaggregation of pentadal totals, using either ERA5(rnl) or IMERG(sat); it is not separate daily station blending. Record the actual daily variant, aggregation and UTC labels. Daily-event conclusions depend on this choice.
observations.avoid: Native global daily NetCDF download through the generic HTTP route can be very large; first prove an efficient bounded subset path. Rhiza coarsening is an explicit source transformation.

cheaper_public_dry_spell_alternative.candidate: Fourteen-day longest dry spell or probability of a seven-day dry run at a fixed calendar issuance, calibrated against matched daily observations. This horizon cannot verify the default3-day-trigger plus21-day-guard onset definition.

cheaper_public_dry_spell_alternative.access_check_limit: Official archive/README verified; direct selected-year directory listing failed through web tool. No field/HTTP-range retrieval tested. Confirm cheap spatial window reads and genuine daily endpoints before any bulk acquisition.
cheaper_public_dry_spell_alternative.calibration_limit: Already bias-corrected/downscaled ensemble mean, not raw GEFS members. Define a further calibration method honestly; do not invent ensemble members or present this as raw-model postprocessing.

native_methods_and_independent_grading.reference_plan: Independent scalar rainfall-window and run scanner, checked against native helpers on frozen genuine daily fields plus small diagnostic boundary fixtures. Keep daily amounts and actual24-hour bounds independently checked before deriving events.
essential_controls: False onset followed by qualifying dry run
Late onset needing complete guard tail
Missing/interior dates versus genuinely failed onset
Runs spanning season or forecast-horizon boundaries
Private target observations excluded from acquisition catalogue
native_methods_and_independent_grading.onset_calibration_blocker: No-onset is a distinct outcome, not missing data and not an ordinary onset-day tercile. Native aggregation is supported, but a scientifically specified calibrated four-outcome or censored-time contract and its independent parity are still needed. Do not silently drop failed seasons into calibrate/tercile helpers.
native_methods_and_independent_grading.readiness: No frontier inference justified yet. First freeze one genuine daily archive subset, verify daily intervals/tail/observation variant, build independent parity and controls, then decide whether the supported helpers offer useful scientific implementation assistance.
